name: direction collapses to four arcs, so 'behind' spans a hundred and eighty degrees
an arc STARTS at its name instead of being centred on it -- straight ahead reads as 'ahead right'
a negative bearing falls off the end of the table
loudness flattens -- a slam and a scuff read as the same line
the ordinary case gets marked too, so the marking stops meaning anything
THE CAPTION BECOMES AN X-RAY -- a sound the player could not have heard is printed anyway
a sound masked to nothing by the street is captioned regardless
an unknown kind prints its own internal id at the player
the caption drops the direction, which is the one thing hearing would have given free
captions appear at the 'speech' level too -- somebody who asked for subtitles gets sound captions
old:
if (level != CaptionLevel.SpeechAndSound) return null;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(kind)) return null;
new:
if (level == CaptionLevel.Off) return null;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(kind)) return null;

name: the hush never clears, so the player is told they were noticed and never told it passed
old: if (alreadyShown && hush <= HushClearBelow) return "[the street picks up again]";
new: if (false) return "[the street picks up again]";
